read.title: Keyword Update for the Cica Cream Listing
read.text:
Team,

Last month, our Cica Cream listing lost sales because its organic ranking dropped to page three. After checking the search term report, we found that many shoppers use phrases like 'redness relief cream' and 'sensitive skin moisturizer.'

We have added these phrases to the title and bullet points. Similar words, such as 'centella' and 'barrier cream,' were added as backend keywords. Please do not repeat words that already appear in the title.

Our goal is to rank for both phrases on page one within four weeks. This should drive traffic to the listing without raising our ad spend.

Thanks,
Minsu

write.en: Report to your manager on the sunscreen listing keyword update: new search terms, backend keywords added, and the expected traffic increase.
write.model:
Hi Ms. Park,

I reviewed the search term report for our sunscreen listing. Many shoppers search for 'no white cast sunscreen,' so I added it to the title. I also added 'reef safe' and 'daily SPF' as backend keywords. We hope to rank for these terms on page one, which should drive traffic to the listing next month.

Best,
Minsu
